name: Edge Case — Unrecognized Quick Reply Option
goal: Verify bot re-shows quick replies when user enters an unrecognized value for a quick reply step.
constraints: User types a value not in quick replies at CC Category step. On second attempt, user selects valid option.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-shows quick replies for CC Category.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
